summary: Hinshelwood started and assisted in Thursday's 4-0 European win, a good sign for his form, but it makes a league start against Newcastle on Sunday less likely. Groß, Gómez, Ayari and Andrés have started every league game; Yalcouyé is out for six to 10 weeks and Mitoma is due back on 2 Dec.

claims.text: Came on for Ayari at Hull; rated 4.75 and 'could not replicate the energy' of the man he replaced.
